actions.action: Isolate the endpoint from the internal network and revoke VPN access to prevent lateral movement.
Force password reset and terminate all active sessions for identified user profiles (e.g. jcloudy).
Revoke OAuth access tokens for Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, and Google Drive for the suspect account.
Deploy GPO or EDR policy to block unauthorized USB mass storage devices across sensitive endpoints.
Quarantine 1 high-risk files identified in user staging/cloud directories.
